import subprocess,re
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'jobpipe.py','apply-csv','--priorities','Medium','--statuses','Needs user','--limit','1','--headless','--continue-on-user']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=270)
safe=re.sub(r'[\w.+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}','[redacted-email]',r.stdout+r.stderr)
safe=re.sub(r'https?://[^\s"\']+','[redacted-url]',safe)
print('NON_SUBMIT_DIAGNOSTIC=true')
print('TARGET_COMPANY=Alteryx')
print('EXIT_CODE',r.returncode)
print('OUTPUT_TAIL',safe[-13500:])
